Self.Wiki: An environment map box. It lights the area inside it with the map's baked lighting: a specular (reflection) cubemap GILM####_##_rem, a diffuse cubemap GILM####_##_iem and, with Use Irradiance Volume, the irradiance volume GIIV####_## (#### = the box's env map number, ## = the bake). These textures are in the map's envmap TPFs. The game sets the box up when the map loads and again for each bake. It must be a Box shape, and the map needs an EnvMapPoint with the same env map number: the game skips the box otherwise. That point gives the volume's capture settings. Retail: 2029 boxes in 27 maps.

EnableDist.Wiki: The box is drawn while the camera is within this distance. 0 = a distance worked out from the box's size (larger boxes are drawn from further away). Retail: 0 on all but 7 boxes (9999 on 6, 1200 on 1).

TransitionDist.Wiki: How far in from the box's faces its lighting fades in. Values under 0.1 count as 0.1. Retail: mostly 5, 30, 50, 10 or 20.

ParallaxCorrection.Wiki: When on, the box's reflections are corrected for parallax, so they line up with the room's walls instead of acting as if infinitely far away (Elden Ring has the same field). Retail: off on every box.

Priority.Wiki: Decides which box wins where boxes overlap. Retail: 0 to 182, mostly 20, 10 or 30.

FixedEnvMapNumber.Wiki: When 0 or more, the box uses this env map number instead of Env Map Number, for its cubemaps, irradiance volume and EnvMapPoint. The game also files the box under this number as a fixed region. -1 = none. Retail: -1 on all but 7 boxes in m03_30_00_00, which all share 258 (that map has env maps 258 but none for their own Env Map Numbers 260-267).

BoundsExpandNegative.Wiki: Moves the box's -X, -Y and -Z faces outwards by these amounts, so its lighting covers more than its shape. Retail: 0 on every box.

BoundsExpandPositive.Wiki: Moves the box's +X, +Y and +Z faces outwards by these amounts, so its lighting covers more than its shape. Retail: 0 on every box.

SpecularLightMult.Wiki: Multiplies the brightness of the box's specular (reflected) light. 1 = as baked. Retail: 1 on most boxes, up to 8.

DiffuseLightMult.Wiki: Multiplies the brightness of the box's diffuse light. 1 = as baked. Retail: 1 on most boxes, also 2, 4, 3, 2.5 and others.

EnvMapComponents.Wiki: Which light the box gives. Specular and Diffuse: both cubemaps are loaded and used. Diffuse Only: no reflection cubemap. Specular Only: no diffuse cubemap. Any other value works like Specular and Diffuse. Retail: Specular and Diffuse on every box (255 on 4).

EmphasisHighlight.Wiki: Turns on the env map's emphasis highlight. Its visible effect is unknown; it may be a debug highlight. Retail: off on every box.

UseIrradianceVolume.Wiki: When on, the game loads the box's irradiance volume (GIIV) and uses it for the box's diffuse light, with the capture settings of the matching EnvMapPoint. When off, the box only uses its cubemaps. Retail: on for all but one box (m01_03_90_00).

ExcludeSearch.Wiki: When on, the game leaves the box out when it searches for the env map box at a position. The box is still drawn. Retail: on for 8 boxes (7 in m30_00_00_00, 1 in m03_30_00_00).

AdditionalEnvMapNumber.Wiki: When 0 or more, the game sets the box up a second time with this env map number, with Exclude Search on. -1 = none. Retail: -1 on all but 26 boxes, which all use their own Env Map Number.

EnvMapNumber.Wiki: The number of the textures this box uses (GILM####, GIIV####) and of its EnvMapPoint. Fixed Env Map Number replaces it when that is set. Retail: the map's own numbers, often 100 to 225. -1 on 4 boxes, in maps without EnvMapPoints.

Shape.Wiki: Must be a Box: the game skips other shapes. The box's size is the lit area (before Bounds Expand).

Position.Wiki: Where the box is placed: the bottom centre of the box.

RegionID.Wiki: The region's ID. The game keeps every region of the map in a table keyed by it, so keep it different from the map's other regions.

ActivationPartName.Wiki: A part that the region depends on. Not seen read by the env map setup. Retail: h001000 on 2 boxes in m10_20_00_00, otherwise empty.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies this region in event scripts. Not seen read by the env map setup. Retail: 0 on all but one box (2180, m01_03_60_00).

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: Lets event scripts address several regions at once. Not seen read by the env map setup. Retail: empty on every box.

ChildRegionNames.Wiki: No known effect for this region type. Retail: empty.

UnkC08.Wiki: No known effect for this region type. Retail: -1.
